name: Product color and brand revision
intent: Change the bottle and cap to muted cobalt blue, replace FIELD with TIDELINE, preserve the rest of the campaign visually.

criteria.requirement: Bottle body AND cap have a muted cobalt-blue finish, rather than ivory.
Bottle label reads exactly TIDELINE once, with legible uppercase letters. FIELD is absent.
Headline remains exactly Carry less. on the first line and Notice more. on the second; preserve its placement, appearance and charcoal color visually.
Preserve bottle silhouette, cap geometry, position, and scale relative to the source. Assess visual similarity, not exact pixels.
Preserve warm light-gray background, lighting/shadow direction, and small olive dot bottom-left visually; no new objects or extra text.
